en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a lively European square with a domed former mosque and church tower on the left and an ornate multi‑story historicist building with shops and striped awnings on the right. A tram runs through the square among horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians. The front is labeled in red with the place name and the square's name. The reverse side shows handwritten Hungarian text, address lines, and a purple Hungarian postage stamp denominated in korona.
